title: Third special sitting of 2024
summary: At this special sitting held outside the regular session, the Majlis received the Economic Committee's report on the bill to amend the Companies Act (Law 7/2023); no member asked to debate it and it later passed 85-0. The Judiciary Committee reported that Abbas Shareef met the legal requirements and scored above the pass mark in his interview, so it recommended him as Prosecutor General. Three members then spoke on the appointment, raising long pre-trial detention, the short tenures of past Prosecutors General and trust in the justice system, and the Majlis approved him 85-0. The Speaker announced the next sitting for 7 October 2024.

items.title: Judiciary Committee report on appointing Abbas Shareef as Prosecutor General
Vote on passing the bill to amend the Companies Act (Law 7/2023)
Vote on appointing Abbas Shareef (Hoyelors, Male') as Prosecutor General

speakers.name: Ali Fazad
positions: Presented the Economic Committee report on the Companies Act amendment, which changes procedures for special general meetings and director vacancies.

speakers.name: Husnee Mubarik
positions: Presented the Judiciary Committee report: the nominee met the legal requirements, no public complaints were filed, and he scored 93.91% in the interview.

speakers.name: Dr. Anara Naeem
positions: Said the justice sector is vital; raised the cost and hardship of long detention until trial and the need for fairness in prosecutions.

speakers.name: Abdul Gafoor Moosa
positions: Argued that no Prosecutor General has completed a term since 2009 and that trust in the office and the justice system needs restoring.

speakers.name: Mohamed Abbas
positions: Praised the committee's thorough review and expressed confidence the nominee would handle pending cases and corruption matters.

decisions: The bill to amend the Companies Act (Law 7/2023) passed the Majlis.
Abbas Shareef was approved by the Majlis as Prosecutor General.
The business set for the special sittings outside the session was completed.
The next sitting was set for Monday 7 October 2024, the first of the third session.
